P7527.corridor_notes: GEM's SegmentName ('Zongyang Hejian Station...' -- no, corrected: SegmentName is 'Lujiang-Chaohu Gas Pipeline', zh_segment '庐北—严桥输气管道') and StartLocation/EndLocation ('Lubei'/'Huashan') are corroborated by a verified primary tender document (ah.zhiliaobiaoxun.com) for '环巢湖天然气高压管线工程庐江-巢湖段（严桥-花山）管道安装工程-2标段' -- i.e. this pipeline is explicitly one of the two named sections of the broader 环巢湖 (Huanchaohu) project also covered by this batch's P7526 (see that PID's blockers for the overlap flag). The tender document's own project-level route detail: DN700 pipe, 6.3MPa design pressure, total length ~119.038km (matches GEM's LengthMergedKm=119.00 almost exactly), annual capacity 12.981 bcm. The specific construction section (标段2) documented in the tender runs 银屏镇 (Yinping Town, Chaohu City) -> 安巢经开区 (Anchao Economic Development Zone, Chaohu City), passing through 含山县 林头镇 and 清溪镇 (Lintou and Qingxi towns, Hanshan County, Ma'anshan) and crossing the 裕溪河/清溪河/汤河 waterways -- i.e. this is the eastern/final leg of the full Lubei-to-Huashan alignment, not the whole route. The pipeline's westward continuation from 严桥 (Yanqiao town, Wuwei City -- geocoded separately for P7528) back to 庐北 (Lubei, Lujiang County) was not independently re-verified at station level in this pass (see blockers) but is consistent with GEM's own field data and a broader secondary-source picture of the line crossing Lujiang, Wuwei, and Hanshan counties en route from Lujiang to Chaohu.
P7527.researcher_notes: Operating status and ~119km length are both well-corroborated. Endpoint place-name resolution is asymmetric: the Huashan/Anchao end is solidly sourced at industrial-park level from the same primary tender document that names the whole project; the Lubei/Lujiang end is only pinned to the county-seat town (庐城镇) since no source in this pass named a specific station address for 'Lubei' -- it reads as a directional descriptor ('north Lujiang [gate station]') rather than a place name Nominatim can resolve directly. Yanqiao (严桥镇), which appears in this pipeline's segment name ('庐北—严桥输气管道') and independently geocodes to a real town in Wuwei City (31.4058546, 117.7238440) -- NOT Lujiang County as might be assumed from the pipeline's naming -- is treated here as a waypoint the trunk line passes through en route to Huashan, and as the western terminus of the separate, shorter P7528 (Chaohu-Wuwei) lateral that branches off at Yanqiao toward Wucheng. This Yanqiao/Wuwei-crossing detail reconciles P7527's and P7528's otherwise-confusing overlapping place names.
P7527.blockers: Could not obtain a station-level address or a fresh independent source for the 'Lubei' (庐北) terminus specifically -- the only detail available names a general direction ('north Lujiang County') rather than a station address; treat the start coordinate as a loose county-seat-level anchor. Could not independently verify the full alignment through Yanqiao/Hanshan beyond the tender document's own final 22.62km section (银屏镇-安巢经开区) plus GEM's pre-existing field data -- a broader confirming source (an EIA report page at sthjt.ah.gov.cn) is geo-blocked from this environment (China-only IP allowlist, HTTP 403) with no Wayback snapshot available.
